title: Main Puttar Jawan
body:
Meri Mona Kammar Jhuka Chori (x2) Tey Payshiyan Khoon Rwaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Assi Loog Shareef Madinay Dey
Kadi Galiyan Mour Na Veekhay(x2)
Mastooran Tey Majbooran Nu(x2)
Main Aap Bazar Lay Aya
<<DIVIDER>>
Main Ghairatan Wala Abid Han
Tusi Sabar Mera Azmao Na (x2)
Main Baywa Bhain Dey Haatan Vich(x2)
Khud Shaam Da Zeevar Paiya
<<DIVIDER>>
Sajjad Di Khasta Haali Da
Ais Gal To Andaza Ker Lo (x2)
Jinay Qaidi Bhain Dey Laashay Nu(x2)
Aik Cholay Vich Dafnaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Tafsseran Paak Quran Diyan
Ajj Baaj Gillaf Day Aiyan(x2)
Tussan Qaidi Parday Daaran Nu(x2)
Sir nangay Shaam Pharaiya
<<DIVIDER>>
Sirr Saang Tay Aalma Valay Da
Ay Manzar Vekh Kay Dig Penda (x2)
Haath Rassiyan Zahra Jaiyaan Nay (x2)
Sirr Mittiyan Naal Lukaaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Tatheer Di Varis Majmeyaan Jay
Rayhi Boldi Naal Shaarbi Day (x2)
Baara Okha Zahra Jai Nu (x2)
Bazaar Abhoor Karaaya.
